waybackify cache [flags] [command]

Cache-store ops: add · fill · verify · remaster · sync

The cache-store command group — populate, verify, remaster, and
project the wayback.charlie.dev mirror image:

  add       fetch ONE capture (+ its requisites) into a cache root
  fill      drive a whole ledger to full asset closure (bulk, resumable)
  verify    check a cache root against its own sidecars (fsck)
  remaster  build a standalone remastered root from a hermetic one
  sync      emit the bucket-population batch (cap/ objects) for a root

Run `waybackify cache <verb> --help` for a verb's full surface.

Flags:
  --help|-h   Show help

Commands:
  add         Fetch one capture into a local bucket image
  fill        Fetch every capture a ledger references into a cache root
  verify      Verify a cache root against its own sidecars
  remaster    Remaster a hermetic cache root into a standalone root
  sync        Emit the bucket-population batch for a cache root

part of the wayback.charlie.dev mirror tooling
